tools.name: ga4_run_report
tools.title: ga4 run report
tools.description:
Run a GA4 analytics report with intelligent query planning. Supports 52 metrics, 63 dimensions, auto-pagination.
Use ga4://metrics and ga4://dimensions resources for available fields. Max 9 dimensions + 10 metrics per request.

startDate.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD or relative (7daysAgo, yesterday)

endDate.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD or relative (today, yesterday)

datePreset.description: Named reporting period. Use the custom date range when you need exact start and end dates.

orderBy.description: Metric or dimension key to sort by

orderDirection.description: Sort direction for the selected ordering field.

limit.description: Maximum number of returned items or rows. The declared bounds and default apply; use pagination for additional results.

offset.description: Optional 0-based row offset for explicit pagination.

autoPaginate.description: When true, omit the limit so the GA4 client paginates through all rows using offset.

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query. Existing MCP Apps fields are returned alongside result.

tools.title: ga4 run realtime report

metrics.description: Realtime metric API names, e.g. activeUsers, eventCount

dimensions.description: Realtime dimension API names, e.g. eventName, city, deviceCategory

minuteRanges.description: Optional named realtime minute ranges; zero is the current minute.

limit.description: Maximum number of returned items or rows. The declared bounds and default apply; use pagination for additional results.

keepEmptyRows.description: Keep provider rows whose selected metrics are all zero, where supported.

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query. Existing MCP Apps fields are returned alongside result.

tools.name: ga4_run_advanced_funnel_report
tools.title: ga4 run advanced funnel report
tools.description: Run the GA4 Data API v1alpha runFunnelReport endpoint with optional breakdown/next-action, falling back to read-only step counts if unavailable.

name.description: Optional display name for this funnel step

eventName.description: GA4 event name matched by a FunnelEventFilter

fieldName.description: Optional GA4 field name for a FunnelFieldFilter, e.g. pagePath, pageTitle, deviceCategory

fieldValue.description: String value to match for fieldName

matchType.description: String match type for pagePath or fieldName

isDirectlyFollowedBy.description: Require this step to directly follow the previous step

withinSecondsFromPriorStep.description: Maximum seconds from the prior step

steps.description: Ordered funnel steps using eventName, pagePath, or fieldName+fieldValue

isOpenFunnel.description: Allow users to enter at any funnel step instead of requiring the first step.

breakdownDimension.description: Optional breakdown dimension, e.g. deviceCategory or sessionDefaultChannelGroup

breakdownLimit.description: Maximum breakdown values to include in the funnel response.

nextActionDimension.description: Optional next action dimension, commonly eventName

nextActionLimit.description: Maximum next actions returned for each funnel step.

startDate.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD or relative (7daysAgo, yesterday)

endDate.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD or relative (today, yesterday)

datePreset.description: Named reporting period. Use the custom date range when you need exact start and end dates.

limit.description: Maximum number of returned items or rows. The declared bounds and default apply; use pagination for additional results.

fallbackToStepCounts.description: If the advanced funnel is unavailable, return independent step counts with the limitation made explicit.

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query. Existing MCP Apps fields are returned alongside result.
